diner.name: Current SQUABBLEHOUSE SHIFT: nine staff and Side of Hands support

interpretation: Matched bot-vs-bot deck-composition evidence, not human win rates or isolated card strength.
Both crews use identical opponents, district seeds, rotations, tiers, seats, policies and shared orderKey.
The diner crew is the exact current SQUABBLEHOUSE SHIFT: nine staff cards plus Side of Hands, which remains a support card rather than staff.
Ability event counts are descriptive only; eligibility denominators and reliability are unknown.

squabble-house-manager.name: Squabble House Manager
squabble-house-manager.effect: On Reveal: If an enemy is here, gain +1 Hand.

plug.name: Plug
plug.effect: Your next card in another district costs 1 less Motion.

waterboy.name: Water Boy
waterboy.effect: On Reveal: If another friendly card is here, gain +1 Motion.

squabblehouse-security.name: Squabblehouse Security
squabblehouse-security.effect: On Reveal: The strongest enemy here loses 2 Hands. Ongoing: the first enemy played or moved into this district each round loses 1 Hand, and Security gains 1 Hand. Protection, immunity, and movement locks can stop the hostile effect.

squabblehouse-teknician.name: Squabblehouse Teknician
squabblehouse-teknician.effect: On Reveal: Repeat the latest other friendly Squabblehouse staff On Reveal once (including Bus Boy, Cashier, and Waffle Warlord). The first other staff played into this district each round also repeats its On Reveal once. No eligible staff means no repeat; ongoing Janitor, dogs, and Teknicians are excluded.

griddle-master.name: Griddle Master
griddle-master.effect: On Reveal: The strongest enemy here takes 2 damage and 1 Burn. If already burning, it takes 4 damage instead. Protection, immunity, and district defenses can stop the hostile package.

inmate-reformed.name: Inmate Reformed
inmate-reformed.effect: On Reveal: If another friendly Squabblehouse staff member is here, gain 2 Hands. The strongest enemy here loses 1 Hand either way. Protection and immunity can block the hostile effect.

janitor.name: Janitor
janitor.effect: Ongoing: The first hostile Hands reduction or harmful status that would affect a friendly card in this district each round is negated. That card gains +2 Hands instead. Disabled Janitors cannot reverse an attack; duplicate Janitors share one district trigger.

laundry.name: Laundromat Regular
laundry.effect: On Reveal: Cleanse your weakest other ally here and give it +1 Hand. Its next successful move cleanses it again and gives it +1 Hand, once.

nail.name: Nail Tech
nail.effect: On Reveal: Give another friendly card here +2 Hands. The next time that card is hit by an enemy Hands reduction, reduce that loss by 1.

alice.name: Alice
alice.effect: Ongoing: At round end, return to your hand once per match, except during the final round. Your next deployment gains +3 Hands and costs 1 less Motion, minimum 1.

cheshire.name: Cheshire
cheshire.effect: Ongoing: While in your hand or on the board, the first ally returned to your hand each round leaves a 6-Hand Grin in its district. Maximum one friendly Grin per district.

queenofhearts.name: Queen of Hearts
queenofhearts.effect: On Reveal: Execute the weakest enemy here if it has 6 or fewer Hands. A successful execution summons a 2-Hand Card Guard. Protection can block execution.

mrrabbit.name: Mr Rabbit
mrrabbit.effect: Ongoing: While in your hand, other friendly characters returned to hand cost 1 less Motion on their next deployment (minimum 1). While on the board, gain +1 Hand each time another friendly character returns to hand.

dorothy.name: Dorothy
dorothy.effect: On Reveal: Return your weakest other friendly character in any district with a printed cost of 2 or less to your hand. Its next deployment costs 1 less Motion (minimum 1) and gains +1 Hand.

guap.name: GUAP
guap.effect: On Reveal: Gain +1 Hands for each other friendly character across the board, up to +5. Give every enemy across the board -1 Hands. Once per round. Ongoing: While GUAP is in your hand, your other Fire characters gain +1 Hands at round end.

alchy.name: Alchy
alchy.effect: Ongoing: On round 4 or later, gain +1 Hands at round end. Gain an extra +1 if you are losing this district.

madhatter.name: Mad Hatter
madhatter.effect: On Reveal: Return your weakest other ally here to hand with +1 Hand and −1 Motion on its next play (minimum 1). If there is room, pull your strongest movable ally from another district here. The cheaper guest also gains +3 Hands; the other gains Protection if still on the board. Equal costs: +1 Hand each. If alone here, gain +2 Hands.

folks.name: FOLKS
folks.effect: On Reveal: Apply 3 Burn to every enemy on the board. Give every other friendly Fire character +1 Hand. Burn deals its stacked Hands loss once at round end; Fire deals +1 Burn against Plant.

hooper.name: Hooper
hooper.effect: On Reveal: Challenge the strongest enemy here through next round. If it leaves this district, gain +3 Hands. Otherwise, at the end of next round, hit it for 3 and gain +1 Hand. One challenge per Hooper.

bbldemon.name: BBL Demon
bbldemon.effect: On Reveal: Mark the strongest enemy district with Drama until the next enemy character placement or match end. Played there: that character gets -2 Hands. Played elsewhere: BBL Demon gains +2 Hands. One Drama per side.

cornercoach.name: Corner Coach
cornercoach.effect: On Reveal: Coach your weakest eligible ally here through next round. Later friendly placements retry its failed entrance until one succeeds. Coachable: Edgar, Nguyen, Man-Man, Transplant, Bodega Cat, Dog Walker, Sports Prodigy, Homeless YN, Dragonfly Jones, OG Uncle, Barber Bro, Night Shift Medic, Squabble House Worker — Female, The Feds. No other kits qualify.

cognac.name: Cognac Bottle
cognac.effect: On Reveal: Give your weakest friendly character here +2 Hands, or +3 if it is Fire.

krump.name: Krump
krump.effect: On Reveal: If an enemy is here, gain +1 Hands and give the highest-Hands enemy here -1 Hands.

dancecaptain.name: Dance Circle Captain
dancecaptain.effect: Ongoing: Once per round, the first friendly dancer move sets a destination. The next different friendly character moving there gains +2 Hands and Protection. Dancers: Break, Bboy, Dance Circle Captain.

og.name: OG Uncle
og.effect: On Reveal: If your opponent has more total cards on the board than you, gain +3 Hands. If they have at least 3 more, also give their lowest-Hands card here -1 Hands.

baby.name: Baby Momma
baby.effect: On Reveal: Name your weakest other ally here as family. Once, follow its successful move if there is room. Once per match when an enemy damages it, hit the attacker for 2; if family was destroyed, also gain +2 Hands.

scarecrow.name: Scarecrow
scarecrow.effect: On Reveal: Swap districts with your weakest ally in another open district. If both can move, both gain +1 Hand. If there is no legal ally to swap with, move to the first completely empty legal district and gain +1 Hand.

tinman.name: Tin Man
tinman.effect: Ongoing: The first other ally entering your district each round gains +1 Hand and Protection. It gains +2 Hands instead if it moved here or is another Oz traveler (Dorothy, Scarecrow, Tin Man, or Lion). Playing or moving an ally here qualifies.

oz.name: Oz
oz.effect: On Reveal: Once per match, repeat the most recent eligible entrance by another friendly Oz traveler (Dorothy, Scarecrow, Tin Man, or Lion) still on the board, including earlier rounds. If none is eligible, repeat the most recent eligible entrance by another friendly character. If that ally moved this round, it also gains +2 Hands. Cannot repeat ability-copying effects.

lion.name: Lion
lion.effect: On Reveal: Gain Protection if you are alone here. Ongoing: Once per round, when another ally leaves your district, gain +2 Hands.

passportbro.name: Passport Bro
passportbro.effect: On Reveal: Move your weakest other ally here to your weakest other open district. Ongoing: Once per round, when another Water ally leaves a district you are losing, cleanse it and give it +2 Hands.

break.name: Break
break.effect: On Reveal: Move your weakest other ally here to your weakest other open district. If it moves, leave a floor mark here through next round: Weaken the next enemy character entering. One mark per district per side.

bboy.name: Bboy
bboy.effect: On Reveal: Move through your weakest other occupied friendly district, then to the remaining district if open. Gain +1 Hand per successful move, up to +2.

wickedwitch.name: Wicked Witch
wickedwitch.effect: On Reveal: Deal 2 damage to each enemy with bonus Hands here; gain +1 Hand for each affected enemy. Summon one Flying Monkeys here if there is space.

flyingmonkeys.name: Flying Monkeys
flyingmonkeys.effect: On Reveal: Move the weakest enemy here to their weakest other open district and give it 1 Burn. Protection, movement locks, and a full district can stop the move.
